Claim.description: subject predicate object over a valid interval, recorded at a Ledger transaction (ADR 0002 §2). id hashes everything but recorded_at, superseded_at, supersedes. An inferred claim names its model in provenance; an observed or stated one has confidence not_applicable and no model (ADR 0006 §3).

ClaimItem.description: a Memory claim as known at as_of; the envelope repeats the claim's epistemics

ConfigurationItem.description: a configuration record and what it configures

Delta.description: later - earlier, component by component, between two calibration records, in their declared form and unit; never converted (neptune-memory ADR 0014)

DocumentSpanItem.description: a span of a document or table record and its extracted text

EvidenceItem.description: source bytes and what the Ledger's resolve said at the snapshot

FrameItem.description: one sensor sample at one instant

ResolutionFinding.description: a resolver finding, bi-temporal like a claim; id hashes code, claim, others and provenance (ADR 0006 §5)

SceneItem.description: a spatial subgraph in one named frame

SeriesWindowItem.description: a window [start, end) of one stream on one of its clocks

unit.description: a quantity's unit exactly as declared; it inherits the claim's provenance
the unit both calibrations declare, as declared; not_applicable for a form without one (a quaternion, a rotation matrix)

description: Neptune Context's context packet (neptune-context ADR 0003): a header, items, claims superseded since as_of, resolver findings and gaps. Claims, findings and the compiler types they reuse are copied from Memory's graph-schema export. Generated from neptune_context.packets; the Python reader in neptune_context.packets.codec is stricter (ids, budgets and cross-references are recomputed).
title: Neptune Context packet, version 1
